mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

No decision on the version numbering scheme is currently recorded for this project, so no scheme is stated here. This document should be updated once a decision is made and recorded.

cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says that no version numbering decision is currently recorded, so it names no scheme.

Muninn has no decision or standing rule on the version scheme. Its catalog lists only the https, verification, rustls and cache decisions, and `muninn why` reported the evidence as insufficient.

The only related traces are two one-word replies from separate sessions, "calver" and "semver". Both are unconfirmed (trust 1) and they contradict each other. Neither was recorded as a decision, so I left both out of the file.

The Bash call to create the file was rejected by a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
